records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-09-02) then silence; no invite sent, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:c305fc86, email:51f2b071). Single-user Starter account with 8 days left; unaided activation looks unlikely but not impossible given early project creation.

draft.subject: A hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Since you created your first project in Wrenfield, the usual next step is bringing someone else in -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to do a short call this week and walk through what you want Timber Labs to get out of Wrenfield first.

And if now isn't the right moment, just say so and I'll stop chasing.

Best,
Chidi
